uncited: - Input: Set of surfels $S$ with accumulated screen-space gradient magnitudes across all training views, and a flag indicating the end of a training epoch.

- `surfel`: Contains geometric and appearance parameters, plus a `cumulative_gradient` field (float) that accumulates the magnitude of the loss gradient projected onto screen space across all views in an epoch.

**Accumulate Gradients:** During the training epoch, for each surfel $i$ rendered in each view $v$, compute the gradient of the loss $\mathcal{L}$ with respect to the surfel's parameters, project it to screen space, and compute its magnitude $\|\nabla_{\text{screen}} \mathcal{L}_i^{(v)}\|$.
**Check Zero Gradient:** At the end of the epoch, iterate through all surfels $i \in S$.
**Prune:** If `surfel[i].cumulative_gradient` equals zero, remove surfel $i$ from $S$.
- **First Epoch:** If a surfel is initialized but never rendered (e.g., completely outside all frustums), its gradient will be zero, and it will be pruned immediately.
Time and memory complexity are not given in the sources.
